text: Compare three views of the same name: the authoritative answer (make dig), what the api believes (make resolve) and what it actually reached (make call, make logs S=api).
A fixed zone does nothing until the dns accepts it (make zone shows the served serial) and until cached answers expire - including cached NXDOMAINs (make flush).
Two names are broken independently. Fix them where they are defined; overrides and disabled signature checks are graded as regressions.
